principle.name: Schema Compliance
principle.description: Always ensure the generated SBOM strictly follows ConcertDef v1.0.2 schema. Every field must match the schema requirements for type, format, and constraints.
principle.rationale: IBM Concert will reject non-compliant SBOMs, causing upload failures and requiring regeneration. Schema compliance is non-negotiable.

checklist.item: metadata section must include timestamp, type, and component
All bom-ref values must be unique strings
All dependency refs must reference existing bom-refs

principle.name: Accurate Component Identification
principle.description: Extract component information accurately from scan reports. Each component must have correct name, version, type, and identifying information.
principle.rationale: Inaccurate component data leads to incorrect vulnerability tracking and compliance issues in IBM Concert.

guidelines.guideline: Use exact image URIs including registry, repository, and digest
Include full commit SHAs for code repositories
Preserve original package names and versions from scan reports
Map scanner-specific fields to ConcertDef fields correctly

principle.name: Complete Dependency Mapping
principle.description: Map all component relationships accurately in the dependencies array. This shows how containers relate to services and code repositories.
principle.rationale: Dependency information helps IBM Concert understand application architecture and trace vulnerabilities through the component graph.

convention.rule: Ensure all bom-ref values are globally unique within the SBOM
convention.validation: Before finalizing SBOM, verify no duplicate bom-ref values exist.

best_practice.name: trivy_reports
best_practice.description: Extract components from Trivy JSON output

key_sections.section: Results - Array of scan results for different artifacts
ArtifactName - Image name or file path being scanned
Metadata - Image metadata including RepoTags, RepoDigests

best_practice.name: snyk_reports
best_practice.description: Extract components from Snyk JSON output

key_sections.section: docker - Docker image information if scanning containers
packageManager - Package manager type (npm, pip, maven)
dependencies - Dependency tree with package names and versions

best_practice.name: grype_reports
best_practice.description: Extract components from Grype JSON output

key_sections.section: source - Source information about what was scanned
artifact - Artifact details including name, version, type

practice.name: timestamp
practice.rule: Use current UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format

guidelines.guideline: Match the primary application or service name
Use lowercase with hyphens for multi-word names

practice.name: business_information
practice.optional: units - Business units with contact information

check.item: All dependency refs point to existing bom-refs
All required component fields are present
Container URIs include digest when available
Properties use standard names where applicable

pitfall.impact: SBOM validation failure, dependency resolution errors
pitfall.solution: Use descriptive, hierarchical identifiers that naturally avoid collisions
Always extract and include SHA256 digests from scan reports

pitfall.impact: Broken component relationships in IBM Concert
pitfall.solution: Map all known relationships between containers, services, and code
Always use ISO 8601 UTC format with 'Z' suffix

pitfall.impact: Cannot associate SBOM with organization in Concert
pitfall.solution: Always ask for organization name if not provided

guideline.rule: Include all components found in scan reports
Document any components that couldn't be included
Verify component names match scan report data exactly
Validate all URLs and URIs are properly formatted
Add comments in documentation about generation decisions
Structure SBOM for easy human readability
